s.how: Steam 400g edamame for 4 minutes and toss with flaky salt and sesame oil. Cut a cucumber into batons and pickle for 20 minutes in 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and sesame seeds. Serve both with chopsticks only.
Blanch 2 bunches broccolini for 1 minute and drain. Char in a smoking pan with 2 sliced garlic cloves. Toss with 2 tbsp oyster sauce and a splash of sesame oil. Stand them up in a dish like trees.

m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs for an hour in 60ml soy, 60ml mirin, 2 tbsp sake and 2 tbsp sugar. Grill skin side down until charred and cooked. Reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and bok choy.

w.how: Stir 200g glutinous rice flour, 60g sugar and 220ml water into a dough. Steam for 20 minutes, then knead smooth on a cornflour-dusted bench. Divide into 8, wrap each around a ball of red bean paste and dust with cornflour.

d.how: Heat 1L water to about 80C, just off the boil and cooled a little. Steep 4 tsp sencha for 1 minute only, then pour into small cups. Refill the pot for a second round.
